title: The Moiré Rosette & Halftone Screen Interference
discipline: Prepress Lithography · Halftone Screen Geometry · Moiré Optical Kinetics · Swiss Concrete Typography (Karl Gerstner & Emil Ruder)
hypothesis: Can interactive digital typography simulate offset printing's AM halftone screens, demonstrating that rotating screen angles (Δθ) between 0° and 90° oscillates typography between pulsating, low-frequency kinetic Moiré waves and crystalline, high-frequency Rosette dot patterns, turning printmaker errors into an intentional typographic grammar?
